annotations.title: List a month of found issues

description: Lists the issues found in one UTC month on the sites of every team the caller is a member of: the findings of each run report of that month, by day, then site, then their order in the report, each with its day, host, site ID, run ID, finding ID, section, title, and label. `month` is YYYY-MM and defaults to the current UTC month. `team` names one team by slug and answers 403 when the caller is not a member of it.

month.description: UTC month as YYYY-MM; defaults to the current UTC month

team.description: Slug of one team the caller is a member of

name: listIssues
title: List a month of found issues
